data.name: Setup_Info_What
data.value: An eight-step assistant to prepare this project: team, models, checks and limits. It proposes from your files, with no network and without spending your usage limit. Nothing is saved until you press "Apply the changes".

data.name: Setup_Info_Actions
data.value: Review each step and change what you want. Turn a step off to leave it as it is. See in the summary everything you chose. Apply: saving the check commands or sensitive permissions asks for Windows Hello.

data.name: Setup_No_Project
data.value: Open a project to set it up.

data.name: Setup_Load_Failed
data.value: The project could not be read ({0}). Check that the folder exists and open the assistant again.

data.name: Setup_Apply_Failed
data.value: It could not be applied ({0}). What was already written stays as it was; check the result and try again.

data.name: Setup_Include_Step
data.value: Save this step (turn it off to leave it as it is)

data.name: Setup_Model_Default
data.value: the default model of the program

data.name: Setup_Project_Size_Truncated
data.value: Size: {0} (at least {1} files: the index was cut)

data.name: Setup_Project_Uncommitted
data.value: You have changes in git that are not saved: save them before you start a run.

data.name: Setup_Project_Nothing_Run
data.value: This comes from the names of the files. Nothing of the project is run and the network is not used.

data.name: Setup_Brief_Hint
data.value: Tell the agents what the project is and how work is done in it. The judge does not read it, so it reviews without influence. If you do not change it, nothing is saved.

data.name: Setup_Team_Hint
data.value: Who works on the project. Small: orchestrator, one executor and judge. Medium: also a lighter executor. Large: also a reviewer.

data.name: Setup_Team_Never_Removes
data.value: The assistant only adds and changes: it never removes an agent you already have.

data.name: Setup_Models_Hint
data.value: Which model each agent uses and how much it thinks before it answers. We recommend one and say why; you can pick another right here.

data.name: Setup_Models_None
data.value: The catalog has no model for the program of this agent.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Hint
data.value: How do we know the work is right? With the commands that build the project and run your tests.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Unreadable
data.value: The commands file you already have cannot be used. Fix it or delete it yourself: the assistant never overwrites it.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Hello_Note
data.value: Windows Hello will be asked when you apply, because these commands run on your computer.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Same
data.value: These are the commands you already have.

data.name: Setup_Skills_Hint
data.value: Skills for each agent: extra know-how chosen by the technology of the project and its role. None is turned on by itself: tick the ones you want.

data.name: Setup_Skills_None
data.value: The catalog has no skills that fit this project.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Hint
data.value: How far each run of this project can go. If you do not change them, the usual ones stay.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Time_Hint
data.value: How long each attempt of an agent can last, from 1 to 240. Empty: the system decides.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Unattended_Note
data.value: Work while you are away: a run can go on by itself after a usage limit or a restart. You give that permission when you approve each plan, not here.

data.name: Setup_Summary_Hint
data.value: Everything you chose, step by step. What is marked "Saved" is written when you press "Apply the changes"; the rest stays as it is.

data.name: Setup_Summary_Empty
data.value: There is nothing to save: everything stays as it is. Press "Go to work" to start.

data.name: Setup_Summary_Hello
data.value: Windows Hello will be asked before the check commands or the sensitive permissions are saved.

data.name: Setup_Summary_Budget
data.value: {1} agents at once, {0} agent attempts per run, {2} per attempt
data.comment: {0}: agent attempts per run. {1}: agents at once. {2}: minutes, or the system's own time.

data.name: Setup_Result_Roster_Changed
data.value: You changed the team: approve again the plan that was waiting.

data.name: Setup_Result_Recorded
data.value: It is noted in the history of the project.

data.name: Setup_Hello_Message
data.value: Confirm it is you to apply {0}.

data.name: Text_setup_models_light_executor
data.value: It is the lighter executor of the medium team: for test or writing tasks.

data.name: Text_setup_verification_no_stack
data.value: We do not recognise the technology of the project. Write the commands yourself; each one has an example below it.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_brief_unreadable
data.value: The brief could not be read because the history of the project does not verify. Check the history before you save anything.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_profile_unreadable
data.value: The file of the check commands cannot be used. Fix it or delete it yourself.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_record_failed
data.value: It was applied, but it could not be noted in the history because the history does not verify. Check the history.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_brief_not_available
data.value: This installation cannot save the brief.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_brief_not_saved
data.value: The brief could not be saved: it is empty, too long, or the history does not verify.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_agent_invalid

data.name: Text_setup_problem_profile_not_saved
data.value: The check commands could not be saved: {0}

data.name: Text_setup_problem_roster_not_saved
data.value: The team could not be saved: {0} The agents saved before the error stay saved.

data.name: Text_setup_hello_subject_profile
data.comment: What Windows Hello is asked for (setup.hello.subject-profile). {0}: .NET, Node or Python.

data.name: Text_setup_problem_options_not_saved

data.name: Text_setup_budget_parallel_tasks_out_of_range

data.name: Text_setup_budget_time_out_of_range

data.name: Text_setup_hello_not_composed

data.name: Text_setup_hello_not_confirmed

data.name: Text_setup_hello_another_pending

data.name: Text_setup_hello_not_asked
data.value: Windows could not ask you to confirm.

data.name: Setup_Project_Hint

data.name: Setup_Team_Plan_Note
data.value: Changing the team withdraws the approval of the plan that is waiting.

data.name: Setup_Verification_None

data.name: Setup_Verification_Restore_Current
data.value: Back to the ones you have now

data.name: Setup_Verification_Try_Hint
data.value: It runs on a copy of your latest saved version and cannot change your project. It can read your files and use the network, as when you run the tests yourself. Your unsaved changes do not count.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Trying
data.value: Trying… It can take a few minutes.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Trial_Passed

data.name: Setup_Verification_Trial_Failed

data.comment: Name of the section for the information button.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Info_What
data.value: These are the commands the system runs to know whether the work is right. They run on a copy and cannot change your project, but they can read your files and use the network. Tests only count if they leave their report in the folder {results}. The history keeps the fingerprint of each version you save.
data.comment: What it is. {results} is written as it is.

data.name: Setup_Verification_Info_Actions
data.value: Change any command. Leave one empty so it does not run. Try them now on your latest saved version. Save them: it asks for Windows Hello.
data.comment: What can be done here, one action per line.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Parallel_Hint
data.value: How many agents work at the same time, from 1 to 8.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Runs_Hint
data.value: How many times in total an agent can be started in one run, from 1 to 200.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Providers
data.value: Each program also has its own cap of agents at once: {0}.
data.comment: {0}: each program of the team with its cap, as the adapters fix it (Setup_Budget_Provider, joined).

data.name: Setup_Budget_Provider
data.comment: {0}: the program. {1}: how many agents it runs at once at most.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Info_Title

data.name: Setup_Budget_Info_What
data.value: The limits stop a run before it goes on too long or spends too much. Besides what you choose here, each program works with a fixed number of agents at once. If you ask for more, they wait their turn.
data.comment: What it is.

data.name: Setup_Budget_Info_Actions
data.value: Choose how many agents work at once. Choose how many times an agent can be started. Choose how long each attempt can last.
data.comment: What can be done here, one action per line.
